name: Again
source:
There are 7 short stories. Each story is a life lived to become Holy Spirit in the end. Stories vary in gameplay: there is rpg story, surgery opperation, puzzle etc Finally all stories get connected.

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1984.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
本作由7个短篇故事组成，每篇都描绘了一段最终化为圣灵的人生。各篇的玩法也不尽相同，包括RPG、外科手术和谜题等内容。到了最后，所有故事都会串联在一起。

[引自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1984.html]vndbreview[/url]]
